history.headline: Aerobic base is proven and the taper has begun. Recent easy runs sit low and controlled. The one untouched variable — loaded, sustained-climb work — will stay untouched now.
watch_items: Watch whether the taper preserves some genuine time-on-feet rather than over-shedding into pure rest — arriving fresh, not undertrained, is the target.
Watch easy-run HR stays in its low band as volume drops; that's the cleanest confirmation the fitness is holding through the wind-down.
Watch recovery consistency as pre-event logistics ramp — sleep has been erratic, and while it doesn't drive training decisions, a run of poor nights near departure is worth simply being aware of.

history.headline: Two weeks out from the crossing, the taper is visibly underway. Recent easy runs sit low and controlled — the aerobic engine is holding as volume winds down. No running logged in three days; the quiet is deliberate.
watch_items: Watch whether the quiet stretch stays a genuine taper or tips into over-rest — a couple of short easy runs before departure would keep the legs primed without adding fatigue.
Watch that easy-run HR stays in its low band whenever running resumes; that remains the cleanest read that fitness is holding through the wind-down.
Watch recovery consistency as pre-event logistics ramp — sleep has been erratic, and a run of poor nights near departure is worth simply being aware of, not acting on.
Watch that strength continues at its current low-intensity cadence rather than escalating close to the event, since it's now the main durability input while running is light.

history.headline: The taper is holding after yesterday's sharp tempo — no follow-up run, which is the right call. Legs got their fast stimulus; now the quiet returns with under two weeks to the crossing.
watch_items: Watch whether any residual soreness or heaviness from the tempo lingers a second day, since that would matter more this close to departure than in a normal week.
Watch that the next runs drop back into the easy band rather than drifting toward yesterday's intensity as habit.
Watch how sleep tracks as travel and pre-event logistics ramp up — note it, don't chase it.
Watch that strength stays maintenance-level and short right through to departure rather than becoming a late durability substitute.

history.headline: Five days without a run — the taper's quiet stretch has held longer than any gap this block. Legs are rested, the engine is banked. Twelve days to the crossing.
watch_items: Watch that the first run back lands squarely in the easy band and feels unremarkable, confirming the tempo left no residue.
Watch whether the strength pause resumes as brief maintenance or stays dark through to departure — either is fine, but note which.
Watch that daily movement and steps hold their baseline through the pause so the legs stay ticking over rather than going fully cold.
Watch how sleep tracks as travel logistics ramp — observe it, don't let it drive anything.

history.headline: Six days without a run — the longest quiet stretch of the block, right on cue. Strength stayed live through the pause. Legs are banked; the crossing is now under two weeks out.
watch_items: Watch that the first run back after the crossing preparation lands easy and unremarkable, confirming the tempo and the long pause left the legs fresh rather than flat.
Watch whether strength stays live as light maintenance through to departure or goes quiet — either is defensible, but note which way it breaks.
Watch that steps and daily movement hold their baseline right up to travel, keeping the legs ticking rather than cold.
Watch how sleep tracks as logistics ramp — observe only, and don't let a rough night or two colour the read on readiness.
